title: Stop target simulation time
steps: affected = get_entities_in_time_stop_scope(actor, target) > for e in affected: simulation_clock.pause(e) > simulate_immune_entities_normally(duration) > on_timeout: for e in affected: simulation_clock.resume(e) > Emit effect/VFX events and run interruption, expiry and cleanup handlers.
examples: Star Platinum — Time Stop; Homura — Time Stop; Time Stop

title: Restore historical state
steps: scope = select_rewind_targets(ability, world) > snapshots = history.read(scope, rewind_target_time) > for entity in scope: restore_whitelisted_fields(entity, snapshots) > reconcile_collisions_and_spawned_entities(scope) > record_temporal_event_for_deterministic_replay() > Emit effect/VFX events and run interruption, expiry and cleanup handlers.

title: Make authored wish transaction
steps: wish = select_or_parse_into_supported_wish_definition(request) > if not lore_and_campaign_rules_allow(wish): return DENIED > reserve_cost_and_simulate_global_consequences(wish) > commit_authored_world_changes_once(wish) > apply_persisted_side_effects_and_story_flags() > Emit effect/VFX events and run interruption, expiry and cleanup handlers.

title: Apply death-mark or defeat trigger
steps: mark = attach_named_death_condition(target, source=actor) > on_qualifying_event(mark): > if death_resistance_or_story_exception_applies(target): return RESISTED > request_lethal_state_transition(target, cause=mark) > remove_mark_and_listener_after_resolution() > Emit effect/VFX events and run interruption, expiry and cleanup handlers.
examples: Crime and Punishment; SCP-049 Lethal Touch; The Lich: Extinction Wish

title: Interact with animals or tame creatures
steps: animal = require_eligible_animal(target) > if this_is_communication: deliver_interpretable_signal(animal) > if this_is_taming: test_bond_or_resistance_rule(animal) > on_bond_success: register_companion_owner_and_ai_orders(animal) > on_failure_or_release: restore_wild_ai() > Emit effect/VFX events and run interruption, expiry and cleanup handlers.

title: Seeded random ability selection
steps: Dispatch into that move's existing execution handler using the caller's combat context. > Record chosen move and seed for reproducible network replay.

title: Atomic position exchange
steps: a,b = validate_swap_targets(actor,target) > pos_a,pos_b = snapshot_positions(a,b) > if can_occupy(b,pos_a) and can_occupy(a,pos_b): > commit_atomic_swap(a,b,pos_a,pos_b) > else: return DESTINATION_BLOCKED > Emit effect/VFX events and run interruption, expiry and cleanup handlers.
examples: Boogie Woogie; Ope Ope no Mi — Shambles

title: Skip or erase time slice
steps: window = world_clock.reserve_interval(duration) > project_state_changes_for_interval(window) > apply_user_exemptions_and_no-contact_rules(window) > commit_consistent_end_state(window) > release_temporal_override() > Emit effect/VFX events and run interruption, expiry and cleanup handlers.

title: Apply age/progression shift
steps: assert target_has_age_or_lifespan_model(target) > if target_resists_temporal_biology_effect(): return RESISTED > alter_biological_age_state_with_bounds(target,age_delta) > recompute_age_dependent_stats_and_visuals(target) > on_revert: restore_whitelisted_age_fields() > Emit effect/VFX events and run interruption, expiry and cleanup handlers.

title: Charged stat enhancement
steps: Handle interrupted charge, status, turn consumption and generation-specific exceptions.

title: Conditional one-shot finisher
steps: For eligible targets request immediate battle completion/defeat without ordinary HP damage. > Consume the Slot command and resolve combat state once; do not claim it copies abilities.

title: Replay last eligible move
steps: action = last_eligible_ally_action_from_combat_history(actor) > if action is None or ability_blacklisted(action): return DENIED > dispatch_effect(action.ability_id, current_caster=actor, validated_target) > do_not_permanently_add_action_to_learned_skill_inventory() > Emit effect/VFX events and run interruption, expiry and cleanup handlers.

title: Change temporary battle elemental type
steps: Resolve damage interactions against the new type profile. > Restore or reset the once-per-entry flag on switching out, according to the current generation.

title: Attack scaled by fainted party members
steps: Resolve an ordinary Ghost-type damaging hit with derived power. > Do not increase permanent base stats or spend fainted teammate entities.

title: Gravity-pulled environment prison
steps: Apply extreme damage/terrain distortion only within a controlled world-region budget. > Expire sink and clean up accelerated/held object state; never simulate literal infinite mass.

title: Equipment-dependent damage type
steps: Resolve the special damaging attack against the target's current resistances. > If no relevant item is held, use the version-specific default attack type.

title: Restore one actor snapshot
steps: Teleport Ekko to the sampled safe position and restore only the explicitly covered personal attributes. > Perform the arrival-area effect and clear invalid history after respawn/map transitions.

title: Steal positive stat stages then strike
steps: Then resolve the damaging attack with the updated stat context. > Honor immunity, accuracy and alternate rules for the chosen Pokémon generation.

title: Consume, analyze and store
steps: Run analysis on stored entities/materials, extracting only permitted skills and resources. > Update the owner's skill inventory/transform options and handle rejected or dangerous contents explicitly.

title: Space-layer interception
steps: Test for special bypass rules (domain, nullification, space-targeting exceptions) BEFORE applying the barrier. > Keep visual proximity and collision separate; prevent projectiles from registering a hit while the barrier intercepts.

title: Reject a causal outcome
steps: Cancel or restore the pending consequence and reset the affected action chain's progress without repeatedly replaying its effects. > Use causal event IDs and recursion guards to prevent infinite event loops.
examples: Gold Experience Requiem — Return to Zero

title: Mounted collision charge
steps: Use a swept large collision volume to strike through enemies and shields. > Exit the charge, restore mount control, and handle obstacles/interruption.

title: Necromantic extraction and roster
steps: Create a shadow-soldier entity from a permitted archetype; register owner, faction and summon-capacity rules. > Add it to a persistent army roster; apply destruction/recall/respawn policies only where defined.

title: Defer and reconcile hit events
steps: When duration ends, combine recorded values according to the ability's intended order and multiplier rules. > Apply the resulting net outcome once; clear ledger and ensure death/disconnect does not duplicate resolution.

title: Damage / healing event escrow
steps: ledger = capture_affected_events(target, window) > on_damage_or_heal(lambda e: ledger.record_or_intercept(e)) > when_window_expires: total = aggregate_once(ledger, rule) > combat_resolver.commit(total, target) > ledger.clear_and_unsubscribe() > Emit effect/VFX events and run interruption, expiry and cleanup handlers.

title: Multiple remote body appendages
steps: Route each proxy's control, grasping hitboxes and damage sharing to the original user. > Retract proxies at effect end; never generate autonomous independent people.

title: Steal property in a moving container
steps: Store the extracted property in the bubble's metadata until popped or recovered. > On bubble destruction or ability release, apply the authored restoration/transfer rule.

title: Stock-based stat junction
steps: Recalculate derived stats on equip, stock consumption and removal; clamp and save the new derived values. > Do not implement Junction as a temporary spell-cast buff.

title: Read and select authored futures
steps: Enforce narrative exceptions via explicit rule predicates; never grant an unrestricted arbitrary-win toggle. > Reconcile the chosen future with world state using authoritative state transitions and restore on failure.

title: Attraction field and power suppression
steps: When holding or contacting a Devil Fruit user, suspend qualifying fruit powers using explicit cancellation rules. > Remove suppression immediately on lost contact, except for separately defined effects.

title: Materialize imagined phenomena
steps: Materialize the phenomenon through typed constructs or world-rule edits; attach ownership and expiry. > Handle self-affecting mental-state changes, concentration loss and deactivation via explicit rule exceptions.

title: Indestructible movement enclosure
steps: On teleport/plane-shift attempts, run the appropriate saving/check sequence if applicable. > Expire/dispell on supported conditions; do not assign normal destructible wall HP by default.

title: Ghoul form state machine
steps: Persist own health/ownership under the new form and update navigation bounds. > On exit/interruption, restore base skeleton/hitboxes and clear temporary appendages safely.

title: Learn from qualifying enemy ability
steps: Future casting dispatches to that spell's own execution logic and resources; learning does not immediately cast it.

title: Transmute existing object to creature
steps: Register growth, movement and potential impact-reflection mechanics only where the selected portrayal supports them. > On reversal, reconcile the original object and any living-instance changes safely.

title: Contact decay and spread
steps: Propagate across connected surfaces only if the current story version allows. > Stop spread at explicit immunity/protection boundaries; synchronize terrain damage.

title: Lock material state
steps: Treat locked air as a solid obstacle when supported by the authored rule. > Release locks safely when the activation condition ends.

title: Select targets by arithmetic
steps: Execute the selected spell on EACH matching target through its actual spell effect handler. > Avoid normal range/line-of-sight assumptions unless the chosen game version explicitly requires them.

title: Blueprint and resource-limited fabrication
steps: Consume lipids and create the corresponding owned physical object atomically. > Apply collision, inventory and persistence after creation; disallow living organisms.

title: Replay object trajectory backwards
steps: During reverse travel, update contacts, carried actors and object collision according to explicit game rules. > At end, resume ordinary physics from the restored position; discard expired history.

title: Transfer through owned shadow
steps: Atomically swap or transfer the owner's position to the shadow anchor, respecting the canon version selected. > Reparent camera/velocity state and broadcast teleport effect without duplicating either entity.

title: Freeze selected world entities
steps: Queue or resolve interactions according to this ability's particular time-stop rules. > Resume suspended objects on timeout, restore their velocities and prevent double updates.

title: Conditional direct-sight power suppression
steps: Allow actions unaffected by Quirk suppression, such as ordinary physical traits, per source rules. > On blink, occlusion or incapacitation, remove the suppression status immediately.

title: Conditional environmental calamity
steps: Resolve hit/environment interactions through normal damage systems and ability-specific exception rules. > Stop the chain when pursuit or ability conditions no longer hold; prevent endless recursive triggers.

title: Restricted binding technique
steps: Spawn an attached chain constraint that binds the qualifying target and suppresses its permitted abilities. > Release the chain on valid break/death/interruption paths and clear all state on save/load.

title: Save return point on activation
steps: On expiry or qualifying death, intercept death completion, transfer the actor to the anchor and apply the specified restoration rules. > Remove anchor and status once used; never allow a second activation from the same marker.

title: Name/contact based rule slots
steps: Compile the requested property change to an authored rule schema and validate its limitations. > Apply and track reversible modifications until the rule slot is released or broken.

title: Alternate spell-cost permission
steps: Preserve timing, additional costs, and spell-casting restrictions; remove the permission if enchantment leaves play. > Do not translate this card as universal information sensing despite its name.

title: Rigged tail with strike and guard
steps: Activate swept melee collision only during attack frames. > Retract without resetting unrelated kagune or form states.

title: Terrain-dependent spell lookup
steps: Select and dispatch its typed effect through the standard combat resolver. > Preserve environmental dependence rather than treating Geomancy as one constant blast.

title: Temporal prediction and skip
steps: Hide or abstract actions in the erased interval from observers; do not apply unearned direct damage by default. > At interval end, reconcile positions, queued outcomes and collision safely; resume the normal event clock.

title: Ukaku RC shard volley
steps: Each shard advances using swept collision; resolve damage and shielding, with hit limits per projectile. > Consume RC resources only if the chosen game rule specifies a budget; retain kagune form after firing.

title: Void volume and spatial erasure
steps: Exit the void only with a safe re-materialization check. > Keep owner visibility/control limits and avoid indiscriminate map deletion.

title: Ultimate directional discharge
steps: Spawn a directional world-rending discharge with an area/volume query, not literal universe deletion by default. > Resolve each target through a configured anti-world resistance/counter rule; apply damage and world-visual distortion. > Record affected targets once per intended hit and clear discharge objects after the active window.
